data.name: Ansell
data.gender_notes: Ansell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name Ansel, meaning 'answering God'. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and was often given to children born into religious families. In the Middle Ages, Ansel was a common name for monks and hermits. The name Ansell carries the meaning “God's answer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ansell usually hope their child will grow to embody god's answer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansell total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
